items.title: Securing AI Agents: Lessons From Real-World Deployment (13 minute read)

items.summary_html: X rebuilt its web app around one server for people, search crawlers, and link previews, replacing three separate servers. On a slow connection, the first post on a profile appears in 2.7 seconds instead of more than 22 seconds, while signed-in traffic is moving over gradually by country.
items.title: Rebuilding the Global Town Square from Scratch (12 minute read)

items.summary_html: Writing externalizes thought, exposes gaps in understanding, and creates room for connections that can be missed while reading or talking to an LLM. Separate unrestricted drafting from ruthless editing, use plain language, write for yourself, and keep a regular schedule.
items.title: Writing as a Thinking Tool (8 minute read)

items.summary_html: Companies offer a starting point for organizing agents through specialization, delegation, management layers, and escalation. Existing communication and project tools can support agent organizations, but identity, authorization, durable state, and human accountability still need to be solved.
items.title: We Already Know How to Work with Agents (5 minute read)

items.summary_html: Working effectively with coding agents depends on clear context, self-verification, early course correction, and explicit boundaries. The advice is to turn repeated corrections into shared instructions, enforce only non-negotiable requirements, and keep humans responsible for product decisions, security boundaries, and what ships.
items.title: Your Coding Agents Made You a Manager (16 minute read)

items.summary_html: Ink is a typed language that compiles state, derived results, and atomic updates together, keeping declared relationships consistent without hand-written cache invalidation. The MIT-licensed working prototype targets JavaScript, native Rust, Rust/Wasm, and eligible WebGPU computation, with proof-checked transformations and explicitly constrained learning.
items.title: Ink: State Is a Program (Website)

items.summary_html: PI-Desktop brings projects, coding agents, models, and workflows into a persistent desktop workspace built with Electron and a Rust host core. Plugins can add tools, panels, MCP servers, and background services, while the application supports switching between cloud and local models.
items.title: PI-Desktop (GitHub Repo)

items.title: Spec Kit (GitHub Repo)

items.summary_html: A TodoMVC example exposes seven browser tools through HTML forms and JavaScript, showing how agents can operate a page without guessing which controls to click. It covers input validation, clear tool responses, untrusted content, and confirmation hints, while explaining why tool calls do not replace UI tests.
items.title: WebMCP, Explained with a To-Do App (12 minute read)

Packed glyphs, overlapping font data, and instruction scheduling reduce memory pressure and rendering cost, including shrinking one font bitmap from 1,140 to 960 bytes.
items.title: JIT Bitmap Text Rendering for Microcontrollers (7 minute read)

In a Dassault Systèmes engineering example, the loop reduced malformed tool calls from 142 to zero and improved the evaluation score by 28% with 35% fewer tool calls per run.
items.title: Use NVIDIA NeMo to Turn Agent Failures into Tests and Harness Fixes (7 minute read)

items.title: A year as a Research Engineer working on RSI at Meta (8 minute read)

Agents are increasingly solving more complex tasks for researchers, but reliability is still low. This post looks at some possible explanations for why.
items.title: What the heck is going on with OpenAI internal AI R&D time horizons (7 minute read)

items.summary_html: OpenRouter has launched the next generation of Auto Router, which outperforms the old router by up to 4x. The launch includes Auto Code, a new router specialized for coding work. The new Auto Router and Auto Code choose models by weighing eleven factors about each request and combining them with live pricing, provider health, and cache status. Users can apply any governance policies, and Auto Router makes efficient choices from the models available.
items.title: Introducing the New Auto and Auto Code Routers (11 minute read)

items.title: A proof of the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture (9 minute read)

Teams can work together without exposing anything to the public internet.
items.title: Ace (Website)

items.title: Yangwang's U9 Xtreme hits 503 km/h (312.65 mph), a one-way record, on tuned rear-wing angle, damping, and tire pressure (2 minute read)

It cut internal cabling 81% (about half a mile of wire), switched to automotive-grade connectors, and added continuous-rotation joints that no longer hit hard stops. A full swerve drive swap drops from a day to about an hour. It unloads up to 1,000 cases per hour (varies with weight and stacking) and fast-charges to 90% in about 75 minutes.
items.title: Boston Dynamics' Stretch Gen 2 cuts internal cabling 81% and swaps a swerve drive in about an hour (3 minute read)

items.summary_html: Superconductors carry current when electrons team up in pairs, but in cuprates (compounds containing copper in an anionic state), scientists couldn't tell if the pairs form early or just don't exist until the material gets cold enough. The team measured electrical noise, which gets louder when charge moves in pairs, and found the extra noise appearing early. That suggests the pairs are already there and are just failing to move together, which could be what limits how warm cuprates can superconduct.
items.title: Physicists used electrical noise to show electrons in a high-temperature superconductor pair up earlier than expected (4 minute read)

items.summary_html: Groq, which used to build inference chips and now operates data centers selling inference capacity, is pitching investors a Series B at $8 billion before new money, versus $3.15 billion in August. Further trials in larger animal models are required before human testing can begin.

items.summary_html: Reasoning is pathfinding in token space. There are many paths from the problem to a correct answer, and the model traverses each of them with each sample. RL training directly raises the success probability. The gains credited to 'thinking longer' come from the search paid for during training rather than at inference.

items.summary_html: Test-time scaling trades compute for performance at test time. Scaling methods that permit the latter change will have a larger impact than test-time scaling considered simply. This essay describes how this may impact the world.
